dish.note: Cocktail sausages rolled in puff pastry and baked golden, for the whole Little family.
dish.how: Heat the oven to 200C. Cut 2 thawed sheets of puff pastry into 24 strips. Wrap each of 24 cocktail sausages in a strip, seam side down on a lined tray, and brush with beaten egg. Bake 18 to 20 minutes until puffed and golden. Serve with tomato sauce and mustard.
dish.make_ahead: Wrap up to 1 day ahead and keep covered in the fridge; bake on the night
